items.title: StyleSmuggler: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE)
items.summary: A zero-day vulnerability (CVSS 10.0) allowing unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution by injecting malicious code into Magento's template system, actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including issues that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability leading to Elevated Access
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 9.1) in Adobe Commerce and Magento that allows an unauthenticated attacker to gain elevated access to sensitive resources without user interaction, with evidence of active exploitation in the wild.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A stored cross-site scripting vulnerability (CVSS 8.7) that could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A stored cross-site scripting vulnerability (CVSS 7.7) that could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Security Feature Bypass in B2B)
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 7.6) affecting Adobe Commerce B2B that could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Security Feature Bypass)
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 7.5) that could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in the Amasty Order Attributes extension allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated PHP Object Injection in Mirasvit Cache Warmer
items.summary: An unauthenticated PHP object injection flaw was found in the popular Mirasvit Cache Warmer extension for Magento, potentially leading to remote code execution.
